set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Result class exposes plan, objective components, formulation, regularization, status, residuals, iterations, and backend.
- print/summary show useful diagnostics without dumping the plan.
- Stable accessors support downstream code.
- Old fields remain compatible or have tested deprecation.
- Serialization and copy behavior are documented.
set.title: Introduce a consistent rfugw transport-result contract
